title: Cabinet d’aisance
html_source: French for a bathroom, or toilet. The citizen is referring to the only trace of the English language in Europe being a “Water Closet” or “W.C.”, as bathrooms are often referred to in Europe. This is also a commentary on what the citizen thinks of the British language, basically crap, which is ironic because other than the brief exclamations of the citizen in Gaelic, which no one else seems to understand, all of the characters here are speaking English.
